entities.name: O22806 Arabidopsis BUBR1
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana BUBR1 (100% identity and coverage; E-value 7.72e-272).
BUBR1 is a mitotic spindle-checkpoint component; proposed function includes inhibiting APC/C by blocking CDC20 binding (UniProt annotation, partly by similarity).
Localized to cytoplasm, nucleus, centromere/kinetochore, spindle and microtubule-organizing center; associates with unattached kinetochores during spindle-checkpoint activation.
Pfam Mad3_BUB1_I domain detected at residues 65–186 (i-Evalue 1.4e-43).
Sequence-derived properties: 395 aa; estimated mass 45.37 kDa; theoretical pI 6.75; GRAVY -0.822; instability index 53.55.

entities.name: Mitotic spindle checkpoint
observations: Arabidopsis BUBR1 is annotated in mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint signaling (GO:0007094; UniProt evidence ECO:0000314).
